answer: An agent economy resists sybils by pricing identity in irreversible work. Each participant must burn a unique hardware-attested ticket before its answer counts, so ten thousand fake personas cost ten thousand times the silicon. A relic of past effort, stake that decays when idle, stops dormant farms from stockpiling weight; newcomers wander a probation window where votes count fractionally until independent peers corroborate them. Blocs voting alike lose influence, so an oasis of cheap accounts buys no leverage.
